note: Pre-approved answers to the replies that come back. The reply helper may send these on its own for the four 'auto' categories; everything else is drafted for the owner and waits. Plain text, same rules as the outreach emails (checked by scripts/check-outreach.mjs).

wants_sample.when: asks for a sample, an example, or to see it
wants_sample.subject: Your sample packet
wants_sample.body:
Hello {{first_name}},

Thank you for writing. Here is the sample packet, five pages made for a made-up resident:

https://cognicopia.org/assets/samples/cognicopia-sample-packet.pdf

To make one for a real resident, open https://cognicopia.org, fill in a few things you know about them, and press the packet button. The first 25 packets are free, with no credit card and no sign-up. I am glad to answer anything else.

Warm regards,
{{sender_name}}
Cognicopia@outlook.com

asks_price.when: asks what it costs or how to buy
asks_price.subject: Cognicopia pricing
asks_price.body:
Hello {{first_name}},

Thank you for asking. The first 25 packets are free. After that, a license for your whole building is {{price_monthly}} or {{price_annual}}. It is paid by card, and the license key arrives by email right after. If your accounts payable team prefers an invoice with 30-day terms, there is a short request form on the pricing page and the invoice and key follow from there.

https://cognicopia.org/pricing.html

If it would help to try it first, https://cognicopia.org/pilot.html has a simple 30-day plan.

Warm regards,
{{sender_name}}
Cognicopia@outlook.com

asks_privacy.when: asks about privacy, security, IT, networks, or HIPAA
asks_privacy.subject: About resident privacy
asks_privacy.body:
Hello {{first_name}},

Good questions, and the short answer is that no resident information leaves the computer. Cognicopia runs in the web browser, and what you type about a resident stays on that computer. It supports your community's own privacy practices; the compliance program itself stays yours.

There is a page that answers the questions IT usually asks, with a security Q and A: https://cognicopia.org/resources/security-questions/

I am glad to answer anything it leaves out.

Warm regards,
{{sender_name}}
Cognicopia@outlook.com

wants_invoice.when: asks for an invoice, a purchase order, a W-9, or net 30 terms
wants_invoice.subject: Invoice and purchase order
wants_invoice.body:
Hello {{first_name}},

Thank you. There is a short form on the pricing page for a purchase order or an invoice with 30-day terms. Fill it in and send it to Cognicopia@outlook.com; the invoice follows, and the license key arrives by email with it. A W-9 is available on request.

https://cognicopia.org/pricing.html

Warm regards,
{{sender_name}}
Cognicopia@outlook.com

unsubscribe.when: asks to stop, says no thanks, or is annoyed
unsubscribe.action: remove from every list now; send nothing, or one line: You have been removed, and you will not hear from us again.

wrong_person.when: says they are not the right person
wrong_person.action: pause the whole facility; draft a one-line thank you asking who is, for the owner to send

out_of_office.action: ignore; the next note goes out on schedule

other.action: draft a reply for the owner and wait
